text: The Governing Council of the University of Toronto (U of T) has appealed Official Plan Amendment No. 231 (OPA 231) regarding the property municipally known as 1440 Don Mills Road (the Lands) to the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal (LPAT). City Council adopted OPA 231 policies for the entire city following the Five-Year Official Plan and Municipal Comprehensive Reviews regarding employment lands. The City Solicitor requires further directions for an upcoming LPAT pre-hearing conference.

City Council on June 18 and 19, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 10, 2019) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of: a. the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 10, 2019) from the City Solicitor with the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 10, 2019) from the City Solicitor to remain confidential, as it contains advice subject to solicitor-client privilege; and b. Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (June 10, 2019) from the City Solicitor.
